t: You're on Duchess Street, in the City of Westminster. It runs from Mansfield Street in the west to Hallam Street in the east, and crosses Portland Place about halfway along. The duchess in the name is Margaret Bentinck, Duchess of Portland. She lived from 1715 to 1785, and was a naturalist, botanist and collector. In her day she was the richest woman in Great Britain. So the street carries the title of a remarkable woman, in a district that still bears the Portland name.
